sourceTitle: Chicken Baked In A Paper Bag
sourceText:
Chicken Baked In A Paper Bag
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 11:26pm

Ingredients




1 (3-5 lb.) roasting chicken
1 cup dried potato flakes
1 cup chopped celery
3 tablespoons melted butter
1/4 cup minced onion
1 tablespoon fresh minced parsley
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Rinse chicken inside and out. Pat skin dry with paper towels. In a small bowl combine potato flakes, celery, butter, onions, parsley, salt, and poultry seasoning. Spoon into chicken's body cavity. Close opening with skewers or tie legs down with heavy string. Place chicken inside a large brown bag being careful that breast does not touch the bag. Fold open end of bag over to close; fasten shut with large paper clips and place on a cookie sheet. Bake 2 1/4 to 2 hours or until chicken is tender.
